rows.replay_summary: Found 3 GEO wound matrices and 73 sample metadata lines. These support a wound-healing seed, but no biofilm/homeostasis packet is bound.
rows.acceptance_threshold: Requires wound + biofilm + homeostasis cases with observables, perturbation outcomes, replay cases, and failure contrasts.

rows.replay_summary: Natural Stories contains processed_RTs=True, processed_wordinfo=True, sample_lines=5. It supports reading-time replay but not roadside perception and not a noise/context manipulation packet by itself.
rows.acceptance_threshold: Requires stimuli, ambiguity/context manipulation labels, RT/response/error fields, thresholds, and replay script.

rows.replay_summary: Zenodo formose reservoir archive has 1410 members and 18 data/script-like files. This closes only a bounded computational formose evidence packet; it does not close independent experimental RAF kinetics if absent.
rows.acceptance_threshold: Zip archive contains formose-labelled computational data/scripts with replayable members.

rows.replay_summary: Found 3 GEO wound matrices, 1 biofilm matrix seed, and UCI diabetes homeostasis surface with 100000 replayed rows and columns encounter_id, patient_nbr, race, gender, age, weight, admission_type_id, discharge_disposition_id, admission_source_id, time_in_hospital, payer_code, medical_specialty. This proves only the bounded K2 comparative packet: wound/biofilm/homeostasis observables can be mapped to perturbation/state-response surfaces.
rows.acceptance_threshold: Wound matrix + biofilm matrix + homeostasis-management table with glucose/HbA1c/medication/readmission observables.

rows.replay_summary: Natural Stories provides reading-time surface and garden-path Zenodo package provides ambiguity/reanalysis data/script members=['results_gp_eng_final_description.txt', 'results_gp_eng_analysis.Rmd', 'results_gp_eng_final.csv']. This closes a bounded K3 ambiguous-sentence processing packet.
rows.acceptance_threshold: Reading-time corpus plus ambiguity/garden-path data or script package present.

rows.replay_summary: Road hazard fixation CSV has 14683 rows and timing/visual-attention fields. This closes only a bounded K3 roadside perception evidence packet.
rows.acceptance_threshold: >=100 rows with visual/hazard context and timing/fixation fields.

rows.replay_summary: CPC18 decision data has >= 50000 rows and choice/outcome columns. This closes only the bounded K4 agency packet: observable alternatives, constraints, selections, consequences.
rows.acceptance_threshold: >=100 rows with choice/button/B and outcome/reward/payoff fields.

rows.replay_summary: Zachary karate network seed has 136 edge rows. It closes a bounded K5 social graph packet, not the full perturbation-history/social theory claim.
rows.acceptance_threshold: >=20 observable social relation edges plus known split context from dataset package.

rows.replay_summary: World Bank WGI replay found public country-year institutional indicator data: API_CC.EST_DS57_en_csv_v2_1437.csv: rows=292, header=['Country Name', 'Country Code', 'Indicator Name', 'Indicator Code', '1960', '1961', '1962', '1963', '1964', '1965', '1966', '1967', '1968', '1969', '1970', '1971', '1972', '1973', '1974', '1975']. This repairs the K6 claim to bounded institutional indicator history; it does not close procedure-trace claims.
OWID/Maddison CSV has 21586 rows with year/GDP fields. This closes a bounded K7 long-run civilization-indicator packet only.
rows.acceptance_threshold: >=1000 entity-year rows with year and GDP-like indicator.

rows.replay_summary: UCI AI4I replay found artifact-state and failure fields: ai4i2020.csv: rows=10000, header=['\ufeffUDI', 'Product ID', 'Type', 'Air temperature [K]', 'Process temperature [K]', 'Rotational speed [rpm]', 'Torque [Nm]', 'Tool wear [min]', 'Machine failure', 'TWF', 'HDF', 'PWF', 'OSF', 'RNF']. This closes the bounded K8 technology artifact/failure packet.
rows.acceptance_threshold: >=1000 rows with artifact state variables and failure label.

rows.replay_summary: UCI Iris replay found supervised classification data: bezdekIris.data: preview_rows=105, token_match=['setosa', 'versicolor', 'virginica']. This closes a bounded AI evaluation-surface packet, not tool/policy perturbation claims.
rows.acceptance_threshold: >=100 labeled rows for held-out classification replay.

rows.replay_summary: C-MAPSS archive has 13 data members and >= 15000 preview rows. This closes a bounded K11 reflexive-monitoring packet: time-indexed sensor state, degradation trajectory, and diagnostic target.
rows.acceptance_threshold: >=1000 time-indexed sensor rows with train/test/RUL-style degradation files.
